bounded_findings: A joint orientation return can be exact while the underlying integer carrier remains non-returning.
The common return period is determined by the declared wheel orders and signed steps, not by visual coincidence.
The 97/99/112/119/120/121 landmarks form an inspectable address ladder inside this finite carrier; they do not constitute a prime generator or universal number law.
The reusable method object is source → signed cyclic views → landmarks → orientation Return / integer residual.
